question: Prashant and Nisha have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Prashant is driving at 117 km/hr while Nisha is driving at 48 km/hr. Find the time taken by Nisha to reach Kanpur if Prashant takes 16 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the distance is constant, the ratio of time taken is inversely proportional to the ratio of speeds.

Ratio of speeds (Prashant : Nisha) = 117 : 48 = 39 : 16

Ratio of time (Prashant : Nisha) = 16 : 39

Given Prashant takes 16 hours, this precisely matches the 16 units of time.

Thus, the time taken by Nisha is 39 units = 39 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 39 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Prashant = 117 km/hr

Time taken by Prashant = 16 hours

Speed of Nisha = 48 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 
• 
 
 
 Delhi
 Kanpur
 

 Prashant (117 km/hr, 16 hrs)
 

 Nisha (48 km/hr, ? hrs)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance from Delhi to Kanpur = 117 × 16

⇒ Total distance = 1872 km

⇒ Time taken by Nisha = Total distance ÷ Speed of Nisha

⇒ Time taken by Nisha = 1872 ÷ 48

⇒ Time taken by Nisha = 39 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 39 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

For equal distances covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂). For varying distances, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed value by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply the speed value by 18 ÷ 5.
